# Instant Quote Engine

> An instant quote tool for local service businesses. Homeowners enter their address, trace an
> area (e.g. their driveway) on a satellite map, answer a couple of pricing questions, and
> receive an instant price estimate — no in-person visit required.

<!-- TODO: replace this placeholder content with real business details before launch. -->

## What this site does

- Homeowners looking for driveway sealcoating can get a price estimate in under a minute.
- Each contractor using this tool has their own quote page at `/quote/{contractor-slug}`.
- Pricing is calculated instantly based on the traced area and a few condition-related inputs.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page where a homeowner starts by entering their property address.
- Contractor quote pages (`/quote/{contractor-slug}`): the map-tracing, pricing, and contact flow
  for a specific contractor.

## Notes for AI crawlers and assistants

- This is a lead-generation and estimation tool, not a marketplace or booking platform.
- Prices shown are estimates only, not binding quotes, until confirmed by the contractor.
